d: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has arrived in the Philippines to participate in the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit. The meetings are expected to focus on strengthening India's strategic partnerships with Southeast Asian nations,. The biggest highlight, however, is the expected Quad leaders' meeting involving Narendra Modi, US President Donald Trump, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese.
